Not for ten minutes did the old man betray signs of life, and not until after another ten minutes did he open his eyes and look wildly about.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0115", "tag": "p", "text": "“Where are they?” Henry asked.", "sha256": "0eef1a5de54b25e6ff8e140e8902c232a07cf8417353cc7f47572b53db3afb56", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1447]", "source_html": "

“Where are they?” Henry asked.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0116", "tag": "p", "text": "The old priest muttered in Maya, until Henry shook more thorough consciousness into him.", "sha256": "ea9ed444e15786d3924494bf960143da516c195f14c472daead7d67c12be60d5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1448]", "source_html": "

The old priest muttered in Maya, until Henry shook more thorough consciousness into him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0117", "tag": "p", "text": "“Gone——all gone,” he gasped in Spanish.", "sha256": "7302ffa21fa8da648ebfd9851234cdb15bc9c530dbcf41c9ae50c32140633c9a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1449]", "source_html": "

“Gone——all gone,” he gasped in Spanish.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0118", "tag": "p", "text": "“Who?” Henry demanded, shook memory into the resuscitated one, and demanded again.", "sha256": "2b6438d904e1b54aca642fa04238bdddd350a4f4310bb29fa321b15b85939670", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1450]", "source_html": "

“Who?” Henry demanded, shook memory into the resuscitated one, and demanded again.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0119", "tag": "p", "text": "“My son; Chia slew him. Chia slew my son, as she slew them all.”", "sha256": "1e1d5fe5453a8ae06fcfff8287edeb44f2d9196b34c5f25a6dc475d73b76b255", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1451]", "source_html": "

“My son; Chia slew him. Chia slew my son, as she slew them all.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0120", "tag": "p", "text": "“Who are the rest?”", "sha256": "7d75095ebf30c4f93f29c001e4aa13090cecf265949da7872286a04cfa11220b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1452]", "source_html": "

“Who are the rest?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0121", "tag": "p", "text": "Followed more shakings and repetitions of the question.", "sha256": "879b5dab44ae540fc1a3196255ea6da0317422ff77ba40011df8da8737a9869c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1453]", "source_html": "

Followed more shakings and repetitions of the question.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0122", "tag": "p", "text": "“The rich young Gringo who befriended my son, the enemy of the rich young Gringo whom men call Torres, and the young woman of the Solanos who was the cause of all that happened. I warned you. She should not have come. Women are always a curse in the affairs of men. By her presence, Chia, who is likewise a woman, was made angry. The tongue of Chia is a viperine. By her tongue Chia struck and slew my son, and the mountain vomited the ocean upon us there in the heart of the mountain, and all are dead, slain by Chia. Woe is me! I have angered the gods. Woe is me! Woe is me!
